title: Trump Media's Stock Fell 54%. Here's What Its Technology Chief's Latest Filing Signals
excerpt: This automatic sell-to-cover execution tied to equity award vesting reduced an executive's direct holdings by 3%.
content_html:
Jonathan Ponciano, The Motley Fool

Fri, August 14, 2026 at 5:30 PM CDT 4 min read

Vladimir Novachki, the chief technology officer of Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. (NASDAQ:DJT), disposed of 29,957 shares of common stock on August 13, according to a recent SEC Form 4 filing.

Transaction summary

Transaction value based on SEC Form 4 weighted average sale price ($8.33); post-transaction value based on the August 13 market close ($8.30).

Key questions

  • What was the nature of the transaction reported by Vladimir Novachki?
    The disposal of 29,957 shares was a non-discretionary transaction carried out solely to satisfy tax withholding requirements. No cash proceeds were received by the chief technology officer in connection with this automatic disposition, which was triggered by the vesting of restricted stock units.

  • How does this disposition affect the insider's total equity exposure?
    Following the transaction, Novachki continues to hold about 914,000 shares directly, representing a 0.33% ownership stake in the company. This holding is valued at $7.6 million based on the August 13 market close, maintaining significant alignment with long-term shareholder value.

  • What is the context of the insider's remaining equity compensation?
    The executive's reported holdings include restricted stock units that carry a contingent right to receive common stock upon vesting. These awards are governed by the firm's Amended and Restated 2024 Equity Incentive Plan and ensure ongoing equity participation for the technical leadership.

  • How has the stock performed leading up to this filing?
    As of the August 13 transaction date, shares of Trump Media have seen a 54% decline over the trailing 12-month period. The company maintains a market capitalization of $2.3 billion based on the August 12 market close.

Company Overview

Company Snapshot

  • Trump Media & Technology Group operates Truth Social, a social networking platform that generates revenue through digital advertising and user engagement services within the United States market.

  • The company's business model centers on building and monetizing a proprietary social media platform designed to serve users seeking an alternative to mainstream social networks.

  • The platform targets a defined demographic of users in the United States seeking social networking services aligned with specific ideological preferences.

根据最近提交的 SEC Form 4 文件，特朗普媒体科技集团公司（纳斯达克股票代码：DJT）首席技术官弗拉基米尔·诺瓦奇基 (Vladimir Novachki) 于 8 月 13 日处置了 29,957 股普通股。

交易概要

交易价值基于 SEC Form 4 加权平均售价（8.33 美元）；交易后价值基于 8 月 13 日市场收盘价（8.30 美元）。

关键问题

  • Vladimir Novachki 报告的交易的性质是什么？ 出售 29,957 股股票是一项非全权交易，仅为满足预扣税要求而进行。 首席技术官没有收到与此自动处置相关的现金收益，该自动处置是由限制性股票单位的归属触发的。
  • 这一处置对内部人的总股权敞口有何影响？交易后，Novachki 继续直接持有约 914,000 股，占公司股权的 0.33%。 根据 8 月 13 日收盘价计算，该持股价值为 760 万美元，与长期股东价值保持显着一致。
  • 内部人剩余股权报酬的背景是什么？高管报告的持股包括限制性股票单位，这些单位在归属时具有获得普通股的或有权利。 这些奖励受公司修订和重述的 2024 年股权激励计划管辖，并确保技术领导层的持续股权参与。
  • 在提交本文件之前，该股的表现如何？截至 8 月 13 日交易日，特朗普媒体的股价在过去 12 个月内下跌了 54%。 根据 8 月 12 日收盘价，该公司的市值维持在 23 亿美元。

公司概况

公司概况

  • Trump Media & Technology Group 运营 Truth Social，这是一个社交网络平台，通过美国市场的数字广告和用户参与服务产生收入。
  • 该公司的商业模式集中于构建专有的社交媒体平台并从中获利，该平台旨在为寻求主流社交网络替代方案的用户提供服务。
  • 该平台针对的是美国特定的用户群体，他们寻求符合特定意识形态偏好的社交网络服务。
